tools.name: understand_site
tools.description: What Orca is, who the site is for, and the public docs. Call this first.

tools.name: match_intent
tools.description: Classify a public-site question (hire a VA, become a VA, Team OS, pricing, existing account, or contact) and return the next URL. Does not look up any person or account.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List public Orca service and region pages. Not live VA profiles.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Public marketplace rates, Team OS, Training, and Scout prices. Checkout on orcarw.com is the source of truth before payment.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: Public FAQ answers with the page they come from.

tools.name: recommend_path
tools.description: Return the canonical public URL for a known goal.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Return a signup or onboarding URL. Does not create an account, send email, or charge anyone.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_signup_link · Private data: match_intent · Public sink: get_signup_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_signup_link · Private data: match_intent · Public sink: get_signup_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
